messages:
Sam: Quick sync — webinar next Wed 2pm PT. Need final runbook: reg gating, Zoom record config, S3 pipeline, clip deliverables. Target: gated replay (14d) + 10 clips + SRTs within 48h. Owners: Maria (reg + emails), Lee (Zoom), Jordan (pipeline), Olivia (clips), Design (thumbs).

Maria: Reg plan: require email + company on replay modal for 14 days, consent checkbox for marketing. HubSpot list = webinar_may_live_reg. Zapier webhook -> HS list + tag `webinar_may_live_replay`.

Lee: Zoom checklist: cloud recording (separate tracks) + auto-transcript (EN). Local host backup enabled. Record active speaker + shared screen separate. Host test Tue 10:30am to verify tracks.

Jordan: Fileflow: Zoom cloud -> auto-download -> s3://redwood-prod/webinars/may_live/{event_id}/raw/ -> transcode & -3LUFS normalize -> deliverables/ -> extract transcript -> write SRT (EN) -> translate job -> SRT-ES/SRT-FR -> chapter JSON -> ffmpeg split -> clips/. Naming: webinar_may26_{eventid}_{clip}_v1.mp4

Olivia: Clips plan: 10 clips (7x30s product/bench, 3x60s speaker). Exports: burned captions for social, -3LUFS, 9:16 + 16:9. QA: caption sync, audio drift, brand-safe. Tag rework `needs-edit` in Airtable.

Design: I will drop 3 hero/thumb options by EOD: speaker close-up, demo still, benchmark stat card. Provide short CTAs: "Try Redwood", "See benchmarks", "Get the dataset".

ReplayBot: Recording processed and uploaded: s3://redwood-prod/webinars/may_live/1769998888/raw/ZoomCloud_1769998888.mp4 ✅

Jordan: Pipeline picked up the file, starting transcode + srt extraction. ETA ~40m. I'll add S3 lifecycle rules (raw -> Glacier 90d).

Maria: Draft cadence: Day0 gated replay + thanks; Day3 highlight clip + trial CTA; Day7 benchmark case study; Day14 replay public + final nudge. I'll paste copy to the campaign doc.

Lee: Compliance note: archive raw to cold after 90d, keep deliverables 24 months, log KMS key, restrict IAM perms to pipeline-integrator.

Sam: Recap: Event Wed -> tech test Tue 10:30 -> auto-upload -> pipeline ~40m -> deliverables by EOD -> clip sprint next day -> gated assets live within 48h. Any blockers?
